scope_note: Corrective audit retains six bounded residual calculations only: FY2025 county tax retained after the provisionally linked incentive, the identical marginal-service-cost break-even threshold, conversion of Meta-reported 2024 water withdrawal with source rounding, and three noncausal county comparison gaps with fit sensitivity. Ten models based on arbitrary capital timing, cost shares, FTE ratios, transferred operating/construction multipliers, fleet PUE, or wastewater ratios are removed. Supplier/local-procurement evidence remains unavailable, so the project is intentionally incomplete rather than backfilled.

sources.title: Meta 2025 Environmental Data Index
sources.notes: Facility tables report Forest City 2024 water withdrawal as 16 whole megaliters. The retained resource model performs only unit conversion with a rounding interval; no fleet PUE, cooling allocation or wastewater ratio is transferred.

assumptions: All transferred coefficients, conversion factors, and allocation shares are exposed as named parameters.

estimates.notes: Same-scope fiscal reconciliation only; no positive or negative net fiscal result is asserted.

parameters.transformation: Positive component of retained county contribution

estimates.confidence_rationale: The threshold identity is exact for the reconciled county claims; actual same-scope public cost remains unobserved.
estimates.decision_relevance: Shows the same-scope annual public-cost threshold that would fully offset the retained county property-tax contribution.

evidence_search.remaining_evidence_gap: Observed marginal county service and infrastructure expenditures attributable to the project for FY2025

derivation.formula: annual marginal county public-service cost at break-even = FY2025 taxes collected − FY2025 incentive payment
assumptions: All transferred coefficients, conversion factors, and allocation shares are exposed as named parameters.
The estimate must not be presented as observed, audited, source-reported, or causal.

limitations: This is a break-even threshold, not an estimate of actual public cost.
A positive margin exists only if same-scope annual marginal costs are below this threshold; a negative margin exists only if they are above it.
The separate 2015 state water grant is not netted because it differs in payer and period.
estimates.notes: No net fiscal result is asserted without same-scope cost evidence.

estimates.label: Unit-converted annual water withdrawal

scope.label: Meta Forest City Data Center campus, Rutherford County, NC

interval.interpretation: The band reflects rounding of the source's displayed 16 megaliters to the nearest whole megaliter before conversion; it is not a confidence interval.

provenance.detail: Exact unit-conversion factor used for presentation

estimates.confidence_rationale: The facility row and conversion are reproducible, but the published amount is rounded and its site-level measurement basis is not specified.
estimates.decision_relevance: Preserves the public facility-level water observation in a compatible presentation unit while the shared canonical evidence metric is absent.

evidence_search.remaining_evidence_gap: Canonical annual water-withdrawal metric, unrounded meter data, withdrawal source allocation, consumption, reuse, and discharge by facility

derivation.formula: reported Forest City water withdrawal in megaliters × 264,172.052 gallons per megaliter
assumptions: All transferred coefficients, conversion factors, and allocation shares are exposed as named parameters.
The estimate must not be presented as observed, audited, source-reported, or causal.

limitations: The source rounds to whole megaliters and allows meter, utility, design-estimate, or proxy inputs where applicable.
Withdrawal is not consumption; no site-specific consumption or discharge value is reported.
The value is not an audited municipal billing record.
estimates.notes: Source-reported facility value carried as a visibly modeled unit conversion because no compatible canonical source metric exists.

estimates.label: Modeled county real GDP comparison gap

period.label: 2024 host-county outcome relative to a mechanically matched benchmark; opening year 2012

scope.label: Meta Forest City campus and Rutherford County

interval.interpretation: Low, central and high values are an explicit sensitivity range, not a statistical confidence interval.

provenance.detail: Rutherford County 2024 real GDP from the county economic panel

parameters.name: comparison_2024_value

provenance.detail: Inverse-distance weighted 2024 value from 20 comparison counties

parameters.transformation: Subtracted from host and used as denominator

estimates.confidence_rationale: The calculation is reproducible but relies on transferred public benchmarks or explicit assumptions where direct local observations are unavailable.
estimates.decision_relevance: Shows Rutherford County's 2024 divergence from a reproducible comparison benchmark without assigning the divergence to the data center.

evidence_search.remaining_evidence_gap: A defensible causal design with treatment isolation, uncontaminated controls, placebo tests, spillover rules, and robustness diagnostics

derivation.formula: 100 × (host 2024 outcome − weighted comparison outcome) ÷ weighted comparison outcome
assumptions: All transferred coefficients, conversion factors, and allocation shares are exposed as named parameters.
The estimate must not be presented as observed, audited, source-reported, or causal.

limitations: This comparison is descriptive and must not be interpreted as a data-center effect.
Opening timing does not isolate later expansions or concurrent investments.
The donor screen excludes study counties but cannot exclude every unobserved data-center or economic treatment.
The interval is a fit sensitivity, not a statistical confidence interval.
estimates.notes: Low-confidence county comparison gap; no causal attribution is made.
